title: PR #54871 added a user notification-option DELETE endpoint that looks up the NotificationSettingOption by id without restricting it to the URL's user, so any user can delete other users' alert notification settings.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: The delete endpoint accepts a user_id from the URL but fetches a NotificationSettingOption by notification_option_id without verifying that the option belongs to the authenticated user. An attacker can delete any notification option in the system by guessing or obtaining a notification_option_id, regardless of ownership.

findings.explanation: The query uses Django ORM's .get() method with a direct field lookup (id=notification_option_id). Django ORM automatically parameterizes queries, preventing SQL injection. The notification_option_id is not interpolated into raw SQL.
The query uses Django ORM's .filter() method with parameterized lookups (user_id=user.id). No raw SQL or string concatenation is used.
The update_or_create() call uses Django ORM with parameterized lookups. No raw SQL is used.

findings.explanation: The delete endpoint accepts a user_id from the URL but fetches a NotificationSettingOption by notification_option_id without verifying that the option belongs to the authenticated user. An attacker can delete any notification option in the system by guessing or obtaining a notification_option_id, regardless of ownership.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a user ownership check: option = NotificationSettingOption.objects.get(id=notification_option_id, user_id=user.id)

findings.explanation: In the put() method, when updating notification settings, the code accepts scope_identifier from user data without validating that the authenticated user has access to that scope (organization, team, or user). An attacker could potentially modify notification settings for other organizations or teams they don't belong to by providing arbitrary scope_identifiers.

findings.suggested_fix: Validate that the user has appropriate permissions for the specified scope. For ORGANIZATION scope, check user membership in the organization. For TEAM scope, verify the team belongs to an organization where the user is a member.
